newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.408 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.408 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.408 percent at its auction of 91-day treasury bills for 80 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 91-day treasury bills on May 2 for a similar amount, the average yield was 6.466 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.475/330 percent against 6.480/445 percent previously.
The central bank said it accepted bids for 182-day treasury bills of 100 million ringgit at an average 6.444 percent against 6.469 percent on May 2.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.500/350 percent against 6.483/440 percent previously.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 364-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on May 22.
